
### P4: control plane  {.smaller}


* P4 control plane is a program 
<hr class="vspace" />
* sends commands to one or more switches: 

   * [load P4 program into data plane]{.fragment fragment-index=2 .custom .myem-only}
   * [set table entries]{.fragment fragment-index=3 .custom .myem-only}
   * [configure multicast groups]{.fragment fragment-index=4 .custom .myem-only}
   * [receive frames to process them]{.fragment fragment-index=5 .custom .myem-only}



### aside: wrappers  {.smaller}


* I'll show code from a P4 controller for upcoming assignment
* written in Python, using custom library to make things convenient
* works with softawre based reference switch 
<hr class="vspace" />
* no requirement to use Python or other specific language 

   * controller sends commands over network/IPC to data plane

* real raw code has more boilerplate/etc.
* probably several things different for hardware-based switches


### againframe(controlToC)

### P4: loading P4 program  {.smaller}

    
<pre><code>p4info_helper =  ....
switch = ....
<span data-fragment-index="2" class="fragment custom myem-only">switch.MasterArbitrationUpdate()</span>
switch.<span data-fragment-index="3" class="fragment custom myem-only">SetForwardingPipelineConfig</span>(
    p4info=p4info_helper.p4info,
    <span data-fragment-index="4" class="fragment custom myem-only">bmv2_json_file_path=bmv2_file_path</span>
)
</code></pre>

### againframe(controlToC)

### P4: setting table entries  {.smaller}

    
<pre><code><span data-fragment-index="5" class="fragment custom myem-only">write_or_overwrite_table_entry</span>(
    <span data-fragment-index="2" class="fragment custom myem-only">p4info_helper=p4info_helper, switch=switch,</span>
    table_name='<span data-fragment-index="3" class="fragment custom myem-only">MyIngress.mac_dst_exact</span>',
    match_fields={
        'hdr.ethernet.dstAddr': <span data-fragment-index="4" class="fragment custom myem-only">some_address</span>,
    },
    action_name='forward_to',
    action_params={'port': port},
)
</code></pre>

### againframe(controlToC)

### P4: multicast groups  {.smaller}

    
<pre><code>switch.Write<span data-fragment-index="4" class="fragment custom myem-only">PRE</span>Entry(
    p4info_helper.buildMulticastGroupEntry(
        <span data-fragment-index="2" class="fragment custom myem-only">multicast_group_id=1</span>, 
        <span data-fragment-index="3" class="fragment custom myem-only">replicas</span>=\[
            {'egress_port': 1, 'instance': 0},
            {'egress_port': 2, 'instance': 0},
            {'egress_port': 3, 'instance': 0},
            {'egress_port': 4, 'instance': 0},
        ]
    )
)
</code></pre>
 ![](/switches/texfig/p4-controlplane-p4-multicast-groups.figure-1.svg){.absolute top="0%" left="0%" width=1050 height=600 .my-center  .fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=1}

### P4: receiving frame  {.smaller}

    
<pre><code>    for item in switch.stream_msg_resp:
        if item.HasField('packet'):
            do_something_with(<span data-fragment-index="2" class="fragment custom myem-only">item.packet.payload</span>,
                              <span data-fragment-index="3" class="fragment custom myem-only">item.packet.metadata</span>)
</code></pre>
